paragraphs: Task Force Tips sells firefighting equipment, technical support and educational resources. A virtual patent marking page lists products including Blitzfire HE, Flex Monitors, Hydrant Master, Metro 0 with a trigger slide valve, and a forestry hose clamp.

An online store is offered to departments that know what they need, with the order sent straight to the station. A dealer network is also offered, guiding buyers from the demonstration through the purchase. The site also carries training video series on rural water supply and hydrant water supply tactics.

The domestic team serves fire departments across the United States, and the international team serves fire departments and safety professionals in other regions. International sales representatives are listed for Canada, Western Europe, the Middle East, Latin America, and Eastern Europe.

quote.text: Providing you with the best firefighting equipment, technical support & educational resources.
